scripts.dev: node scripts/format-changed.mjs && concurrently -n web,server -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix web" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.build: node scripts/format-changed.mjs && npm run typecheck --prefix shared && npm run build --prefix web && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix shared && npm install --prefix web && npm install --prefix server
